categories_thin: Independent hotels: none found. All East Brunswick lodging (Route 18 and Tower Center Blvd) is branded - Best Western, Hilton, Holiday Inn Express, Residence Inn - so nothing qualifies.
Bookstores: only Barnes & Noble (chain) at Brunswick Square; no independent bookstore found.
Craft and hobby retail: no independent craft store in town; nearest is chain Michaels in North Brunswick.
Hardware: no standalone independent hardware store; the independent option is the family-owned 18 Lumber yard (paint, hardware, millwork), listed above.
Tutoring and test prep: the market is dominated by franchises (Huntington, Kumon, C2 Education, Genie Academy, PALS) which are excluded, so only Solution Prep and school-run programs remain.

Self-storage and moving: all in-town self-storage is branded (CubeSmart, Public Storage, U-Haul), and the movers surfaced (Two Men and a Truck franchise, White Glove, M&M Movers) are franchises or based outside town.
Event venues: mostly halls run by fraternal/civic organizations (Elks, fire company) plus one commercial venue (Palmeras), so this category is genuinely small.
Independent pharmacies are excluded by the rules, which also removes the pharmacy/medical-supply crossover shops.
caveats: Zone is the township of East Brunswick only; businesses in Milltown, North Brunswick, South River, Old Bridge and Spotswood that appeared in 'near East Brunswick' searches were excluded even though they are within 10 miles.

Brunswick Square Mall (755 Route 18) is being redeveloped and Nordstrom Rack opened there in late October 2026; several in-mall independents (Lady K Jewels, IRL Game Shop, Repairs By Nathan) may relocate, so confirm addresses before outreach.

Excluded as chains/franchises even where locally operated: FASTSIGNS, Minuteman Press, FedEx Office, The UPS Store, Huntington Learning Center, Kumon, C2 Education, Genie Academy, PALS Learning Center, Lightbridge Academy, Primrose School, Kiddie Academy, School of Rock, Guitar Center, K9 Resorts, Snapology, KidStrong, CPR Cell Phone Repair, iFixandRepair, The DRIPBaR, Mirons Ethan Allen Gallery, Raymour & Flanigan, HomeGoods, Barnes & Noble, Zales, Mandee, PetSmart, Petco, GameStop, Lowe's, Home Depot.
Kept despite being a small multi-location group: Monmouth Cards, The Barker Lounge, Party Fair, Nice Guys Appliance - all New Jersey-based, not national franchises.

Excluded as non-business or out of scope: Middlesex County Magnet Schools (public vo-tech), East Brunswick Public Schools preschool programs, Raritan Valley YMCA, East Brunswick Elks lodge, East Brunswick Jewish Center gift shop (place of worship), Goodwill NYNJ thrift, Labcorp and Quest lab sites.
Many industrial/wholesale entries come from the NJBD bulk directory only and are likely stale; the triage team should confirm each is still operating before outreach.
Where a phone number or street address was not shown in any listing I actually saw, the field says Unknown rather than guessing.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com, WhereOrg, Manta, BBB category pages and Cybo all returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching, so their category lists were visible only through search-result snippets, which typically show the top 5-10 businesses per category.
Google Maps and Bing Maps were unusable from this environment (navigation returned unrelated content), so no map-based completeness check with review recency was possible.

The East Brunswick Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory (ebrcc.org) is a JavaScript app that could not be scraped; it likely lists local retailers, services and manufacturers not captured here.
The NJ licensed child-care dataset API returned an empty result set for East Brunswick, so licensed family/home daycares (home addresses) were not enumerated; only center-based programs are listed.
Manufacturers are likely undercounted: D&B, Manta and Thomasnet detail pages were blocked, so most industrial names come from the NJBD bulk directory and could not be re-verified.
No source allowed confirming recent customer reviews for most entries, so 'active_evidence' relies on own websites and current directory presence rather than activity timestamps.
